$comment: Stage spec: external_attack_surface — DEFINE the attack surface (liveness + port scan + service fingerprint + HTTP probe + screenshots). 阶段重排 2026-06-09: 端口/服务前移到此 (先定义 host×端口×服务×活web); JS/API 移交 enumeration. 见 docs/design/2026-06-09-active-stage-verify-first.md.
$comment_findings_allowed: Attack-surface mapping stage: the deliverable is liveness/port/service coverage, NOT vulnerabilities. submit_stage_deliverable drops any findings submitted here and tells the model to put discoveries in claims. Design 2026-06-15-recon-stage-findings-suppression.
$comment_host_aware: Host-aware coverage 2b (design 2026-06-15-host-aware-coverage §3.2, tightened 2026-07-06): EAS splits vhost liveness/web-origin fingerprinting from host/IP mapping. Concrete IP/CIDR host assets are driven by PORT first; fresh open-port or no-open-port evidence closes LIVENESS. GOLISH-EAS-PORT and GOLISH-EAS-SERVICE-FINGERPRINT apply only to concrete IP/CIDR host assets. GOLISH-EAS-WEB-FINGERPRINT applies only after the asset has a confirmed HTTP(S) surface (httpx/WhatWeb/nmap HTTP service surface). If a domain has no registered IP target, PORT/SERVICE is a target_intel/DNS landing gap, not a domain port-scan obligation. Unknown class keeps fail-safe coverage.
$comment_freshness_window: Phase E activation (design 2026-06-22 Phase D): gray-switch ON. The EAS DB-truth back-fill (GOLISH-EAS-LIVENESS/PORT/SERVICE-FINGERPRINT/WEB-FINGERPRINT) only counts data collected this stage-run (targets.liveness_checked_at/ports_scanned_at + fingerprints.detected_at >= stage start; migration 20260623000001). EAS coverage_complete now uses authoritative DB/ledger found facts, so self-reported found cells cannot fake active surface coverage. Default false = presence-only.
$comment_asset_wave_barrier: Stage expansion wave barrier (updated 2026-07-06): freeze the current EAS coverage denominator to the active durable stage_asset_wave item list, falling back to operation_state.stage_started_at only when no durable wave exists. Assets discovered during the wave are persisted and shown as next_wave_pending, but do not block the current wave's gate. After all current org waves pass, stage_run queues supplemental durable waves for the newly DB-entered assets; the next stage_run call processes only those delta wave assets before the stage can close.

gate_rules.$comment_derive: 2026-07-06 EAS slim closeout: DB business-table truth补格 — GOLISH-EAS-LIVENESS←targets(http_status/real_ip or fresh ports), -PORT←targets.ports, -SERVICE-FINGERPRINT←per-open-port service surface/nmap, -WEB-FINGERPRINT←WhatWeb fingerprints/source outcomes, plus technique_outcomes provenance where available. 真跑工具落库后 coverage 格自动补 found; authoritative_found means a hand-written found cell no longer counts without DB/ledger truth. Negative/blocked terminal cells should use explicit checked_empty or blocked/not_applicable+note until active Empty facts are complete.

on_fail.reason: external attack surface incomplete: some in-scope assets were not fully mapped (liveness / port / service-fingerprint / web-fingerprint)
hints: for EVERY in-scope asset, take each applicable EAS technique to a terminal coverage cell: found / checked_empty / blocked|not_applicable+note. Concrete IP/CIDR host assets should run PORT first; fresh port evidence closes LIVENESS, then every SERVICE-applicable confirmed open port needs SERVICE-FINGERPRINT. Domain/URL/web-origin assets need LIVENESS, and WEB-FINGERPRINT once HTTP(S) is confirmed

intel-source data (FOFA/Shodan/...) is a lead, not proof — actively confirm each asset NOW; the gate auto-projects found cells from DB truth (naabu/masscan→targets.ports + LIVENESS, nmap→service fingerprints, httpx→web liveness, whatweb→web fingerprints) so running the real tools fills coverage; JS/API extraction happens in the NEXT stage (enumeration)

gate_rules.$comment_authoritative: EAS found coverage is now adjudicated from DB/ledger truth (targets.ports + fingerprints + technique_outcomes), so denominator fields should not be hand-copied into the deliverable. coverage_complete owns completeness; denominator remains as a documented no-op for this slim DB-truth stage.

hints: for service fingerprint coverage set tested_units to the number of discovered open ports fingerprinted and total_units to the number of discovered open ports
if a host has no open ports, mark SERVICE-FINGERPRINT not_applicable with a note instead of checked_empty total_units=0
do not treat HTTP liveness alone as PORT or SERVICE-FINGERPRINT coverage

$comment_expected_techniques: EAS = 定义攻击面（阶段重排 2026-06-09：端口/服务前移到此）。coverage_complete 对权威 in_scope_assets 逐资产核 LIVENESS+PORT+SERVICE-FINGERPRINT+WEB-FINGERPRINT 终态；WEB-FINGERPRINT 由 web-capable 证据动态适用；漏一个 = not_attempted = Block。JS/API 已移交 enumeration。
$comment_stage_run: stage_run fan-out (design 2026-06-13-stage-run-fanout §3.2): specialist = the per-org sub-agent the stage_run tool fans out (EAS → prober, the ACTIVE surface-mapper split from Pentester, mirroring recon for target_intel); coverage_axis = the human-readable technique columns StageRunView renders per org row (one per expected technique: liveness / port / service-fingerprint / web-fingerprint).
$comment_min_invocations: 2026-06-25 EAS slim DB-truth closeout: no hard tool floor in the deliverable. Active work is proven by coverage_complete reading DB/ledger facts (targets liveness/ports, fingerprints, technique_outcomes). A required_checks_done/http_probe floor only reintroduces model hand-copying and blocks otherwise valid DB-truth runs.
$comment_facts_from_db_truth: 2026-07-06: EAS now matches target_intel's slim deliverable pattern for found cells. The worker runs active tools and lets DB/ledger truth fill found LIVENESS/PORT/SERVICE-FINGERPRINT/WEB-FINGERPRINT cells; submit only negative/blocked terminal cells the DB cannot derive.
